title: Igor B. Martins
text:
About
  Igor B. Martins


  
    
    Curriculum vitae ↗
  
  
    I am an economic historian and researcher in the Department of Economic History at Lund University.
    I hold an MSc and PhD in Economic History from Lund University and have previously worked as a postdoctoral researcher at Lund and the University of Cambridge.
    My current work contributes to research projects on the political economy of the Cape Colony and the historical development of inequality in Africa. I also examine labour and labour-market integration in Ghana, resilience to economic contraction in developing countries, and the relationship between climate exposure, asset ownership, and inequality.
    Alongside this research, I study changing patterns of international scientific cooperation and their implications for research policy and geopolitics. My consultancy work includes projects for STINT and the United Nations Development Programme.
